outcome: Neurological events during pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum
cohort: 13 pregnant women with MMD who delivered at the University of Tokyo Hospital between 2000 and 2021
finding: The study suggests that pregnant women with MMD, particularly those with the RNF213 p.Arg4810Lys variant, may have a higher frequency of hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (HDP).
mod_finding: Of the 13 pregnancies, nine patients underwent cesarean section, and four delivered vaginally with epidural anesthesia.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 37 weeks
